## MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
RISK-ON: Low volatility 15.6% and broad participation (Breadth 6/8); market favoring cyclicals and financials.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Banking & Finance and Construction & REIT leading: HALKB (1W: +23.15% | 1M: +16.32%) ABOVE TREND; AKBNK (1W: +5.27% | 1M: +15.09%) ABOVE TREND; EKGYO (1W: +6.32% | 1M: +14.06%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology & Telecom and Retail & Food lagging: KONTR (1W: -3.87% | 1M: -19.96%) BELOW TREND; CCOLA (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -15.25%) BELOW TREND; AEFES (1W: -3.24% | 1M: -13.73%) BELOW TREND.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
HALKB (1W: +23.15% | 1M: +16.32%) ABOVE TREND; TRMET (1W: +9.21% | 1M: +15.76%) ABOVE TREND; VAKBN (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +10.65%) ABOVE TREND; EKGYO (1W: +6.32% | 1M: +14.06%) ABOVE TREND; YKBNK (1W: +5.92% | 1M: +15.77%) ABOVE TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
CCOLA (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -15.25%) BELOW TREND; TKFEN (1W: -4.33% | 1M: +46.85%) CORRECTION; KONTR (1W: -3.87% | 1M: -19.96%) BELOW TREND; TUPRS (1W: -3.67% | 1M: +27.88%) CORRECTION; PETKM (1W: -3.59% | 1M: -0.35%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
HALKB (1W: +23.15% | 1M: +16.32%) ABOVE TREND; TRMET (1W: +9.21% | 1M: +15.76%) ABOVE TREND; VAKBN (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +10.65%) ABOVE TREND; ENKAI (1W: +5.55% | 1M: -0.11%) RECOVERY; TRALT (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +22.91%) ABOVE TREND.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking strong and leadership confirmed: AKBNK (1W: +5.27% | 1M: +15.09%) ABOVE TREND; HALKB (1W: +23.15% | 1M: +16.32%) ABOVE TREND; YKBNK (1W: +5.92% | 1M: +15.77%) ABOVE TREND; GARAN (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +5.30%) ABOVE TREND.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Mixed but constructive for producers: EREGL (1W: +1.31% | 1M: -10.57%) RECOVERY; TOASO (1W: +0.92% | 1M: +0.64%) ABOVE TREND; FROTO (1W: -1.44% | 1M: +3.09%) CORRECTION; ASELS (1W: +0.37% | 1M: +13.89%) ABOVE TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Energy showing rotation: TRMET (1W: +9.21% | 1M: +15.76%) ABOVE TREND; TRALT (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +22.91%) ABOVE TREND; GUBRF (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +22.31%) ABOVE TREND; TUPRS (1W: -3.67% | 1M: +27.88%) CORRECTION; PETKM (1W: -3.59% | 1M: -0.35%) BELOW TREND.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Overweight Banking & Finance and selected Energy/Cyclicals; trim Technology & defensive Retail exposure given persistent underperformance and risk-on environment.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
HALKB (1W: +23.15% | 1M: +16.32%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through; TUPRS (1W: -3.67% | 1M: +27.88%) CORRECTION for mean-reversion/earnings flow; EKGYO (1W: +6.32% | 1M: +14.06%) ABOVE TREND on REIT momentum; TRALT (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +22.91%) ABOVE TREND for sector carry.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Banking & Finance for earnings/flow; Energy & Chemicals for commodity price sensitivity and earnings; Construction & REIT for continued yield/real assets inflows.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
XU100 in breakaway RISK-ON posture — watch dip support at the 20-day moving average and prior consolidation lows for re-entry; catalysts: domestic CPI and CBRT commentary, Q3 corporate updates and commodity price shifts.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Low-volatility RISK-ON market with 6/8 sectors positive; banks and cyclical energy/REIT names leading while tech and retail lag. Trade overweight selective financials and energy cyclical exposures, monitor TUPRS and HALKB for near-term setups and macro data as the primary downside trigger.
